82:The tenants waiting for approval (glossary „Freigabeliste der Mandanten“: exactly `supervisionLevel: pending`), longest waiting first, paginated (`?page=&pageSize=`, no filters). A row carries `tenantId`, `tenantName`, `waitingSince`, the `contact`, the `owners` (every owner membership with `userId`, `displayName`, `mail`), the `offerCount` (all bookables plus events) and `lastChange`, the newest history row about the tenant (`tenant.created` = new, `tenant.levelChanged` with `to: pending` = reset, with its reason). `total` is the queue's counter. Approve or decline per tenant with `PUT /api/tenants/:tenant/supervision`. **Instance owner only.**
143:Tenant-scoped routes under `/api/:tenant/bookables`.
145:### GET /api/:tenant/bookables/public
147:Returns the public list of a tenant's bookables: what asks to be listed and passes the tenant's supervision (ADR 0003). Optional auth; a role holder with `manageBookables.readAny` gets the tenant's bookables whole. A tenant without a public projection answers `404 tenant_not_found`.
151:### GET /api/:tenant/bookables/public/:id
155:### GET /api/:tenant/bookables
157:Returns all bookables (including non-public). **Requires JWT.**

253:### DELETE /api/:tenant/bookings/:id
255:Removes a booking for good: its access is taken back, its documents removed, then the booking. Not a cancellation - `POST /bookings/:id/reject` keeps the booking in the state "cancelled".
261:Public JSON bookable responses under `/json/:tenant/bookables` and `/json/:tenant/bookables/:id` (including nested `relatedBookables` and event tickets) include the tenant’s `cancellationRefundTiers` so storefronts can show the refund policy without an extra tenant request.
263:### GET /api/:tenant/bookings/:id/cancellation-refund-preview
267:### GET /api/:tenant/bookings/:id/cancellation-refund-preview/public?name=
271:### GET /api/:tenant/bookings/:id/hooks/:hookId/cancellation-refund-preview
275:### POST /api/:tenant/bookings/:id/reject
279:### GET /api/:tenant/group-bookings/:id/cancellation-refund-preview
283:### POST /api/:tenant/group-bookings/:id/reject
285:Cancels or rejects a group booking. Without an override, each booking uses its policy proposal; an optional `refundPercentage` applies to all bookings in the group. Optional `bankDetails` are rendered on the aggregated cancellation PDF when a refund document is generated. A group that is cancelled already, or whose members differ in state, answers `409 invalid_transition`; an unknown group `404`. The same applies to `POST /group-bookings/:id/commit` and `/pay`.
289:### POST /api/:tenant/bookings/:id/cancellation-receipt
291:Reprints the cancellation document of a cancelled booking as a further revision under the same number, from the stored refund audit. Same right as `POST /bookings/:id/receipt` (booking management `updateAny` or the owner); `409 not_cancelled` without a cancellation. Nothing is mailed.
293:### POST /api/:tenant/group-bookings/:id/cancellation-receipt
295:Reprints the one aggregated cancellation document of a cancelled group booking as a further revision, attached to every member. Same right as `POST /group-bookings/:id/receipt`; `409 not_cancelled` if a member is not cancelled.
315:Endpoints for events, users, bookings, coupons, checkout, payments, calendars, catalog, workflows, access points and rules follow the same pattern: mostly tenant-scoped paths under `/api/:tenant/...` with permission checks via roles and memberships.
